correctness.rationale: Proof separately handles empty and zero-only cores; the exact q-adic support of every 1 synchronizes all occurrences of a bispecial factor containing 1, inducing a bijection to a strictly shorter bispecial ancestor and complementing the full four-pair extension set. This generates all cores, and missing pairs generate exactly all minimal absent words. Nonoverlap follows from q-adic length valuations, and palindromicity from reversal preservation by T_q. Independently generated finite words and direct factor enumeration agree for q=2..9, lengths <=75, but those checks are not used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This exact infinite-scale, all-parameter forbidden basis is a natural combinatorial language invariant, needed to decide factor admissibility by avoidance. The result gives every absent word rather than just a complexity count, explains all-palindromic structure, and identifies 2q-2 genuinely different forbidden words at every substitution scale. The q>=3 multi-seed family is not a mere substitution of a known q=2 formula or an arbitrary finite numerical slice.
